scenario:
A political data analysis firm is developing an enterprise-level platform to track and analyze financial contributions made to political campaigns. The system will collect data on contributions from individuals and Political Action Committees (PACs) across various sectors. The platform aims to offer detailed insights into the financial dynamics of political campaigns, including the total contributions by sector, the distribution of individual vs. PAC contributions, and the historical changes in these patterns over multiple election cycles.

To achieve this, the platform will allow users to categorize contributions by sector and track changes in contribution amounts over time. It will provide advanced analytics and reporting features to identify trends, such as which sectors are increasing their political spending and how contributions impact electoral outcomes. The system must also support robust data management capabilities, including regular updates and data integrity checks.

Additionally, the platform will offer a comprehensive user management system to facilitate collaboration among political analysts, researchers, and campaign strategists. It will enable users to customize reports and dashboards based on their analytical needs and provide secure access to sensitive financial data.
